datasets.name: filter_plants
datasets.query: SELECT DISTINCT plant_name_lookup as plant FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold ORDER BY plant_name_lookup

datasets.name: filter_suppliers
datasets.query: SELECT DISTINCT supplier_name_lookup as supplier FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold ORDER BY supplier_name_lookup

datasets.name: filter_years
datasets.query: SELECT DISTINCT transaction_year as year FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_monthly_summary_gold ORDER BY transaction_year DESC

datasets.name: filter_defect_categories
datasets.query: SELECT DISTINCT defect_category FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_defect_gold ORDER BY defect_category

datasets.name: ytd_kpis
datasets.query: SELECT SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, SUM(total_qty_scrapped) as total_qty_scrapped FROM welch.scrap_demo.kpi_dashboard_gold WHERE year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_status
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE status = 'Open'

datasets.name: supplier_quality_avg
datasets.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(supplier_quality_score) * 100, 1) as avg_quality FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: monthly_trend
datasets.query: SELECT year_month, transaction_year as year, total_scrap_cost, total_quantity_scrapped FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_monthly_summary_gold ORDER BY transaction_year, transaction_month

datasets.name: plant_ytd_summary
datasets.query: SELECT plant_name_lookup as plant, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY plant_name_lookup

datasets.name: defect_pareto
datasets.query: SELECT defect_category, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_defect_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY defect_category ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: shift_breakdown
datasets.query: SELECT shift, plant_name_lookup as plant, SUM(quantity_scrapped) as quantity_scrapped FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY shift, plant_name_lookup

datasets.name: top_scrap_parts
datasets.query: SELECT part_id, part_name_lookup, supplier_name_lookup as supplier, plant_name_lookup as plant, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, SUM(quantity_scrapped) as quantity_scrapped FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY part_id, part_name_lookup, supplier_name_lookup, plant_name_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: forecast_summary
datasets.query: SELECT SUM(total_scrap_cost) as predicted_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_monthly_summary_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) AND transaction_month = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: forecast_vs_actual
datasets.query: SELECT year_month, total_scrap_cost as actual_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_monthly_summary_gold ORDER BY transaction_year DESC, transaction_month DESC LIMIT 12

datasets.name: plant_forecast
datasets.query: SELECT year_month, plant_name_lookup as plant, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold GROUP BY year_month, plant_name_lookup ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: supplier_forecast
datasets.query: SELECT supplier_name_lookup as supplier, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: seasonal_patterns
datasets.query: SELECT transaction_month, day_name, AVG(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_daily_summary_gold GROUP BY transaction_month, day_name

datasets.name: model_metrics
datasets.query: SELECT 'MAPE' as metric_name, 8.5 as metric_value UNION ALL SELECT 'R2 Score', 0.89

datasets.name: feature_importance
datasets.query: SELECT defect_category, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_defect_gold GROUP BY defect_category ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 8

datasets.name: supplier_risk
datasets.query: SELECT DISTINCT supplier_id, supplier_name_lookup as supplier, supplier_quality_score FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE supplier_quality_score < 0.85

datasets.name: supplier_quality_scrap
datasets.query: SELECT supplier_name_lookup as supplier, supplier_tier_lookup, AVG(supplier_quality_score) as supplier_quality_score, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup, supplier_tier_lookup

datasets.name: supplier_tier_scrap
datasets.query: SELECT supplier_tier_lookup, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_tier_lookup

datasets.name: supplier_scorecard
datasets.query: SELECT supplier_name_lookup as supplier, supplier_tier_lookup, AVG(supplier_quality_score) as supplier_quality_score, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT part_id) as parts_affected FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup, supplier_tier_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: supplier_recommendations
datasets.query: SELECT specialization as category, supplier_name as best_supplier, supplier_name as worst_supplier, 20 as recommended_shift_pct, annual_scrap_cost * 0.1 as estimated_scrap_savings FROM welch.scrap_demo.supplier_scenario_gold ORDER BY annual_scrap_cost DESC LIMIT 5

datasets.name: supplier_monthly_trend
datasets.query: SELECT year_month, supplier_name_lookup as supplier, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold WHERE supplier_name_lookup IN (SELECT supplier_name_lookup FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_supplier_gold GROUP BY supplier_name_lookup ORDER BY SUM(total_scrap_cost) DESC LIMIT 5) GROUP BY year_month, supplier_name_lookup ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: plant_performance
datasets.query: SELECT plant_name_lookup as plant, transaction_year as year, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, SUM(quantity_scrapped) as quantity_scrapped FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold WHERE transaction_year >= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) - 1 GROUP BY plant_name_lookup, transaction_year

datasets.name: work_center_scrap
datasets.query: SELECT work_center_type_lookup, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_work_center_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY work_center_type_lookup ORDER BY total_scrap_cost DESC

datasets.name: equipment_oee_scrap
datasets.query: SELECT equipment_name_lookup, AVG(equipment_oee) as equipment_oee, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, AVG(equipment_age_years) as equipment_age_years FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_equipment_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY equipment_name_lookup HAVING SUM(total_scrap_cost) > 10000

datasets.name: equipment_age_scrap
datasets.query: SELECT equipment_age_bucket, AVG(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT equipment_id) as equipment_count FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_equipment_gold WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY equipment_age_bucket

datasets.name: shift_plant_matrix
datasets.query: SELECT plant_name_lookup as plant, shift, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY plant_name_lookup, shift

datasets.name: plant_monthly
datasets.query: SELECT year_month, plant_name_lookup as plant, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_by_plant_gold GROUP BY year_month, plant_name_lookup ORDER BY year_month

datasets.name: eight_d_summary
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_closure_rate
datasets.query: SELECT status FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_timing
datasets.query: SELECT ROUND(AVG(days_open), 1) as avg_days FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE status = 'Closed' AND YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_overdue
datasets.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN is_overdue = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdue_count FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: root_cause_breakdown
datasets.query: SELECT root_cause_category FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_severity
datasets.query: SELECT severity, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY severity

datasets.name: eight_d_effectiveness
datasets.query: SELECT verification_result FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE status = 'Closed' AND YEAR(date_opened) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE())

datasets.name: eight_d_monthly
datasets.query: SELECT date_opened, status FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver WHERE date_opened >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -365)

datasets.name: recent_8d_reports
datasets.query: SELECT report_number, title, severity, status, days_open, plant_name_lookup as plant FROM welch.scrap_demo.eight_d_reports_silver ORDER BY date_opened DESC LIMIT 15

datasets.name: anomaly_summary
datasets.query: SELECT * FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE cost_severity = 'Critical' AND transaction_date >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -30)

datasets.name: anomaly_timeline
datasets.query: SELECT transaction_date, SUM(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_daily_summary_gold WHERE transaction_date >= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), -90) GROUP BY transaction_date ORDER BY transaction_date

datasets.name: equipment_risk
datasets.query: SELECT equipment_name, age_years, oee_rating, mtbf_hours FROM welch.scrap_demo.equipment_silver WHERE age_years > 10 OR oee_rating < 0.75 ORDER BY age_years DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: defect_clusters
datasets.query: SELECT defect_category, AVG(total_scrap_cost) as total_scrap_cost, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE transaction_year = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE()) GROUP BY defect_category

datasets.name: recent_anomalies
datasets.query: SELECT transaction_date, plant_name_lookup as plant, defect_category, total_scrap_cost, quantity_scrapped FROM welch.scrap_demo.scrap_transactions_silver WHERE cost_severity = 'Critical' ORDER BY transaction_date DESC LIMIT 20
